body:
Hi! 👋

We are building **Oqerun Store**, an open-source application catalog for Oqerun OS.

We discovered **Hoppscotch** through GitHub and have added a community listing for it in Oqerun Store:
- Project: https://github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch
- Store app page: https://vruntime-labs.github.io/oqerun-store/
- Linked web app: https://hoppscotch.io/
- License shown in the listing: MIT

The Store does **not redistribute your source code or claim ownership of your project**. The listing links back to your GitHub repository and hosted application and identifies it as a community project.

If you would prefer that the listing be changed or removed, please let us know here and we will act on the request.

Thanks for building open source! ❤️

— VRuntime Labs / Oqerun Store
title: Oqerun Store listing: Hoppscotch
